node.body:
# Worked Example: Memoized Fibonacci Footprint

Fibonacci instrumented in `CostM (Visited ℕ)` ([[node:foundation.cost.visited]]),
so the cost field records the **set of indices** the recursion touches rather
than a call count. Because the `Visited` monoid is idempotent, the footprint
collapses to the distinct subproblems:
$$
  (\operatorname{fib} n).\mathrm{cost}.\mathrm{toFinset}
    \;=\; \{0, 1, \dots, n\} \;=\; \operatorname{range}(n+1),
$$
hence `fib_cost_card : (fib n).cost.toFinset.card = n + 1` — exactly `n+1`
distinct subproblems, the hallmark of an `O(n)` memoized DP.

Correctness and cost are proved independently: `fib_value : (fib n).ret =
Nat.fib n` lives on `.ret`, while `fib_cost` lives on `.cost`. This is the
intended `CostM` separation ([[node:foundation.cost.costm]]).

## Lean declarations

- `MemoFib.fibAux`, `MemoFib.fib` — the instrumented recursion and its wrapper.
- `MemoFib.fibAux_ret`, `MemoFib.fib_value` — correctness (`= Nat.fib`).
- `MemoFib.fibAux_cost`, `MemoFib.fib_cost`, `MemoFib.fib_cost_card` — the
  footprint equals `range (n+1)`, of cardinality `n+1`.

## References

- [Danielsson 2008] Nils Anders Danielsson, POPL 2008. Memoization as an
  idempotent cost monoid ([[node:foundation.cost.visited]]).
node.title: Worked Example: Memoized Fibonacci Footprint

theorems.body:
def fibAux : ℕ → CostM (Visited ℕ) (ℕ × ℕ)
  | 0     => do ✓[singleton 0] pure (0, 1)
  | k + 1 => do
    let p ← fibAux k
    ✓[singleton (k + 1)] pure (p.2, p.1 + p.2)

/-- Bottom-up Fibonacci. Visits each sub-problem in `{0, …, n}` exactly
once. -/
theorems.name: fibAux

theorems.body:
def fib (n : ℕ) : CostM (Visited ℕ) ℕ := do
  let p ← fibAux n
  pure p.1

/-! ### Functional correctness -/
theorems.name: fib

theorems.body:
theorem fibAux_ret (n : ℕ) :
    (fibAux n).ret = (Nat.fib n, Nat.fib (n + 1)) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    show ((fibAux k) >>= _).ret = _
    simp [CostM.ret_bind, ih, Nat.fib_add_two]

/-- The value computed by `fib n` is the `n`-th Fibonacci number. -/
theorems.name: fibAux_ret

theorems.body:
theorem fib_value (n : ℕ) : (fib n).ret = Nat.fib n := by
  show ((fibAux n) >>= _).ret = _
  simp [fibAux_ret]

/-! ### Cost analysis -/
theorems.name: fib_value

theorems.body:
theorem fibAux_cost (n : ℕ) :
    (fibAux n).cost.toFinset = Finset.range (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [fibAux]
  | succ k ih =>
    show ((fibAux k) >>= _).cost.toFinset = _
    simp only [CostM.cost_bind, CostM.cost_tick, CostM.cost_pure,
      Visited.toFinset_add, Visited.toFinset_singleton, Visited.toFinset_zero,
      Finset.union_empty]
    rw [ih]
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_singleton]
    omega

/-- The set of sub-problems touched by `fib n` is exactly `{0, …, n}`. -/
theorems.name: fibAux_cost

theorems.body:
theorem fib_cost (n : ℕ) :
    (fib n).cost.toFinset = Finset.range (n + 1) := by
  show ((fibAux n) >>= _).cost.toFinset = _
  simp only [CostM.cost_bind, CostM.cost_pure,
    Visited.toFinset_add, Visited.toFinset_zero, Finset.union_empty]
  exact fibAux_cost n

/-- Exactly `n + 1` distinct sub-problems are touched by `fib n`. -/
theorems.name: fib_cost

theorems.body:
theorem fib_cost_card (n : ℕ) : (fib n).cost.toFinset.card = n + 1 := by
  rw [fib_cost, Finset.card_range]

end MemoFib
theorems.name: fib_cost_card
